activity.notes: Richard Seddon became Premier of New Zealand on 1 May 1893 and remained head of government until his death on 10 June 1906. Contemporary New Zealand usage called the office Premier; ATLAS displays the Korean functional equivalent 총리.

sources.title: Richard Seddon — NZ History
sources.citation_text: New Zealand's Ministry for Culture and Heritage gives Seddon's premiership as 1 May 1893 to 10 June 1906.

sources.title: 'King Dick' Seddon becomes premier — NZ History
sources.citation_text: NZ History records Seddon's accession as premier on 1 May 1893 and his thirteen-year dominance of New Zealand politics.
